description.zh: 从[GetEmonGrafanaAlerts](~~254890~~)接口中获取的报警列表中的ID之一。您可以按需求指定具体的ID。
description.en: One of the IDs from the alert list obtained through the [GetEmonGrafanaAlerts](~~254890~~) operation. Specify the ID as needed.
The ID of the monitoring alert project, in the format of **es-<yourUID>**.

descriptions.zh: > 此API接口每小时最多被调用10次。
descriptions.en: > This API operation can be called up to 10 times per hour.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch post-emon-try-alarm-rule --project-id es-1330710960320000 --alarm-group-id 123 --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
